Maya (Finance): FYI — Aurelia Diagnostics renewal just landed and there's a mismatch. Platform fee on INV-2026-7983 is ~18% higher than renewal quote, and support was billed at Enterprise but customer says they renewed Pro only. Can someone eyeball before we send?

Maya (Finance): INV-2026-7983 is in the tenant. Proposed correction = platform fee delta $12,345 + pro-rated support refund $3,200 = $15,545 total. That stays under $50k.

Ben (Billing): ok thanks. Need GL code to apply credit and a billing comment for audit. Suggest: "Support tier correction + platform fee adjustment per customer email 2026-02-02". Anyone +1?

Emma (CFO): I approve the $15,545 credit. Please attach the amendment and customer confirmation to the accounting entry. Also note reason in monthly close pack.

billing-bot: Created credit note CN-3456 for $15,545 referencing INV-2026-7983. Status: pending-apply.

Sam (AM): I will notify Aurelia. Draft: "We adjusted your renewal invoice to reflect the previously-agreed Pro support tier and applicable platform fee correction. Attached: revised invoice INV-2026-7983-R and credit note CN-3456. Apologies for the confusion." ok?
Maya (Finance): wording 👍. Please CC finance@redwood and mark ticket PR-1287 done once sent.
Olivia (CS): I'll update the usage notes in the customer file so future renewals reflect the concurrency burst.
Ben (Billing): CN applied, revised invoice generated INV-2026-7983-R. GL posted.
Sam (AM): Email sent to primary contact (tara@aureliadx.com) with attachments, awaiting ack. cc'd finance + billing.
